card.name: Start of a number in dosing tables
card.fires_on: The space or first digit just before a dose amount or percentage in dosing tables, weight-band charts and adverse-reaction lists. It marks the spot where a new number is about to begin.

modes.label: Weight-band dose charts
modes.description: The space after a weight in kg and lb, right before the next dose amount.
